info.name: Webex Admin Address Book Features:  Call Pickup API
Read the List of Call Pickups

params.name: locationId
params.description: Return the list of call pickups for this location.

params.name: orgId
params.description: List call pickups for this organization.

params.name: max
params.description: Limit the number of call pickups returned to this maximum count. Default is 2000.

params.name: start
params.description: Start at the zero-based offset in the list of matching call pickups. Default is 0.

params.name: order
params.description: Sort the list of call pickups by name, either ASC or DSC. Default is ASC.

params.name: name
params.description: Return the list of call pickups that contains the given name. The maximum length is 80.

items.docs:
List all Call Pickups for the organization.

Call Pickup enables a user (agent) to answer any ringing line within their pickup group.

Retrieving this list requires a full or read-only administrator or location administrator auth token with a scope of `spark-admin:telephony_config_read`.

**NOTE**: The Call Pickup ID will change upon modification of the Call Pickup name.

info.name: Get available agents from Call Pickups

params.name: locationId
params.description: Return the available agents for this location.

params.name: orgId
params.description: Return the available agents for this organization.

params.name: callPickupName
params.description: Only return available agents from call pickups with the matching name.

params.name: max
params.description: Limit the number of available agents returned to this maximum count.

params.name: start
params.description: Start at the zero-based offset in the list of matching available agents.

params.name: name
params.description: Only return available agents with the matching name.

params.name: phoneNumber
params.description: Only return available agents with the matching primary number.

params.name: order
params.description: Order the available agents according to the designated fields. Up to three vertical bar (|) separated sort order fields may be specified. Available sort fields: `fname`, `lname`, `extension`, `number`.

items.docs:
Retrieve available agents from call pickups for a given location.

Call Pickup enables a user (agent) to answer any ringing line within their pickup group.

Retrieving available agents from call pickups requires a full or read-only administrator or location administrator auth token with a scope of `spark-admin:telephony_config_read`.
